phase_prompt.label: The Judgment Lineup
phase_prompt.summary: The kings stand paralyzed in a row, stripped of their administrative powers, witnessing the source of true authority. Their digital armor is failing, and the reality of their deletion sets in.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A wide, cinematic angle of five Powerful Kings standing in a rigid line against a backdrop of endless digital darkness. They are illuminated by a harsh, cold blue light emanating from off-camera. Their obsidian robes are sleek but lifeless. They clutch useless glass geometric scepters. Their faces show sweating, hyper-realistic terror. The air around them shimmers with thermal distortion. Depth of field isolates them from the void. Photorealistic style, dramatic drama lighting.
